title: mob-lister
description: A Fabric 1.20.1 mod to list all registered mobs and possible duplicates.
body:
A simple Fabric 1.20.1 mod to list all registered mob types and possible duplicates.

While making a modpack, you might want to know what mobs you ended up with, and if there might be any duplicates. This mod was specifically made for that.

## Usage
1. Add the mod (depends on Fabric API).
2. Use the `/moblister list` command to list all registered mobs. The list may be big depending on the modpack, so you might need to check your logs if it's too long to fit in chat.
3. Use the `/moblister duplicates` command to list all duplicates. Like above, might need to check your logs depending on the size.
